author: rsi_demo
title: G49 · 拒绝
body: I changed only matMul, retaining its proven layout, exactness checks, odd-size tails, output type, and non-FMA fallback while splitting each 2×2 FMA dot product into two exact even/odd partial sums. This doubles the number of independent FMA dependency chains without increasing the multiplication count, targeting the matrix task’s FMA-latency bottleneck and a required whole-call factor above 1.477 while leaving the other seven exports unchanged.
